channel.title: Texas Legislature - Today's Filed Bills in the House
channel.description: Bills filed on 11/13/2026. An appearance of a bill on this list is a result of it being filed by a representative or senator.

item.title: HB 1138 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hayes
item.description: Relating to requiring an election judge to provide a watcher removed from a polling place a signed statement containing the reason for the removal.

item.title: HB 1139 Introduced
item.dc:creator: González, Jessica
item.description: Relating to the repeal of the exemptions from sales and use taxes for property used in certain data centers and large data center projects.

item.title: HB 1140 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Howard
item.description: Relating to the use of dynamic message signs for the Keep 'Em Safe Texas Gun Storage Campaign.

item.title: HB 1141 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Schoolcraft
item.description: Relating to creation and funding of professional teacher academies which are owned and operated by highly qualified teaching professionals in Texas and authorizing the commissioner of education to adopt rules to administer and fund the professional teacher academy program.

item.title: HB 1142 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Canales
item.description: Relating to the use of automated traffic control systems by local authorities and law enforcement agencies.

item.title: HB 1143 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Raymond
item.description: Relating to county purchasing agents in certain counties located on the international border.

item.title: HB 1144 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Landgraf
item.description: Relating to the Texas emissions reduction plan and other related programs to reduce emissions.

item.title: HB 1145 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Raymond
item.description: Relating to the conversion of all or a portion of a municipal sales and use tax originally adopted for the purpose of sports and community venues to a municipal sales and use tax for economic development purposes.

item.title: HB 1146 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Raymond
item.description: Relating to grounds for recounting paperless electronic voting system ballots.

item.title: HB 1147 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Lalani
item.description: Relating to seeking a waiver under Medicaid to provide a continuous period of eligibility under the program for certain children.

item.title: HB 1148 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Lalani
item.description: Relating to the establishment of a middle school career and academic advising program in public schools and to postsecondary education and career counseling academies developed for school counselors and other public school advisors.

item.title: HB 1149 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Martinez
item.description: Relating to the establishment of the Texas airport investment partnership program.

item.title: HJR 78 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Vasut
item.description: Proposing a constitutional amendment relating to the determination of a quorum of the senate or house of representatives.
